opportunity_memo.problem: In the synthetic SIM-A compact reviews, one account dated 2026-10-01 says screws did not align and another person was needed (SYNTHETIC-LIVE-voc.csv#row=2); another dated 2026-10-02 says assembly was easy using the pictured sequence (row=3). An illustrative hypothesis is that alignment or instructions affect assembly difficulty, but user technique or unit variation could also explain the difference. The existing SIM-A compact account with easy assembly is an alternative to assuming a redesign is needed. Test with independently verified products and observed assembly sessions; more data is needed.
sample_limitations: All six dated reviews across two product IDs are synthetic; they do not establish real customer experiences, demand or product performance.
